responseMessageContents.text:
Your project is saved automatically. To get back to it:

1. **Go to [rork.app](https://rork.app)** and log into your account
2. **Find your project** in your dashboard — it will be listed there
3. **Click on it** to reopen the editor and continue where you left off

Your code, settings, and all changes are persisted — nothing is lost when you close the browser.
